purpose: SlicerConnect is a three-module extension (Login, Project Hub, Editor) for real-time multi-user segmentation editing. It syncs labelmap deltas through a hosted backend at slicerconnect.from-delhi.net.
summary: I found no malicious code, but the extension has several real defects. Segmentation data and the auth token go over unencrypted ws://, while the README claims WSS. The code also has crash-level bugs: an undefined `Null` and a missing `json` import break segmentation download and upload, and a stray `m` breaks token refresh. A PyPI package is installed without asking. `spinner.gif` is not installed by CMake. The catalog entry pins `main` instead of a commit. The service is a single-author hosted backend whose source is not in this repo. Data leaves the machine only after explicit user actions, and the README discloses this. The license is BSD-3 and acceptable.
not_checked: Backend server source (separate repository) and its security
